definitions.gloss: school attendance; entering school; enrollment in school
definitions.explanation: The act of attending or enrolling in school, especially compulsory education.

examples.japanese: {就学|しゅうがく}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予防接種|よぼうせっしゅ}→予防接種：11068_yobousesshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Children need vaccinations before starting school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{義務|ぎむ}{教育|きょういく}→義務教育：13964_gimukyouiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{就学|しゅうがく}{率|りつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほぼ→ほぼ：00109_hobo⟧100%だ。
examples.english: The school enrollment rate for compulsory education is nearly 100%.

examples.japanese: {就学|しゅうがく}{届|とどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the school enrollment notification.

notes:
{就学|しゅうがく} is the formal, administrative word for a child entering and attending compulsory schooling. It appears in official language — municipal notices, statistics, legal requirements — far more than in everyday conversation. It is ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive): the child is the subject and takes ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧, and the school takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ rather than ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

WRITING:
{就|しゅう} (to take up) + ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (learning)

COMPOUNDS:
- {就学|しゅうがく}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ - pre-school age
- {就学|しゅうがく}⟦{児童|じどう}→児童：03340_jidou⟧ - school-age child
- {就学|しゅうがく}{率|りつ} - enrollment rate
- {就学|しゅうがく}{届|とどけ} - enrollment notification
- {就学|しゅうがく}⟦{猶予|ゆうよ}→猶予：13496_yuuyo⟧ - deferment of school enrollment

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧ - entering (a specific) school
- ⟦{通学|つうがく}→通学：03510_tsuugaku⟧ - commuting to school
- {修学|しゅうがく} - pursuit of learning (note: different kanji)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {就学|しゅうがく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to enter school
- {就学|しゅうがく}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ - to have a high enrollment rate
- {就学|しゅうがく}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧ - a pre-school-age child
